subject.title: [Feature]:Support per-agent command lanes for multi-agent deployments

question: What public scheduler/config contract should OpenClaw use for foreground per-agent command-lane isolation on shared gateways?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but fixing it adds public config and scheduler semantics that must settle lane ownership, aggregate caps, trust boundaries, and overlap with adjacent lane proposals before implementation.

options.title: Trusted Per-Agent Lanes
options.body: Add a validated agent/defaults config surface that maps agents or groups to server-owned lanes while keeping a separate aggregate safety cap.

options.title: Unified Scheduler API
options.body: Defer implementation until foreground, subagent, hook, and workload-specific lanes can share one coordinated scheduler model.

options.title: Document Process Isolation
options.body: Keep the shared main lane and document separate gateway processes as the supported isolation pattern for heavy agents.

recommendation.title: Trusted Per-Agent Lanes
recommendation.body: Add a validated agent/defaults config surface that maps agents or groups to server-owned lanes while keeping a separate aggregate safety cap.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal across the lane resolver, gateway lane setup, queue docs, and config/default concurrency surface.
